config.experiment: Predeclared Round10 constraint arm: add only 3 scheduling-context features to fixed Round5 seed299 settings. Reused historical development years.

count_selection.rule: Per generator: median of 2019/2020 raw best tree counts, round half up, then clip to [100, 1800]. Fixed for 2021, 2022, final fitting and both seeds.

sampling_rule: Full weekly inputs, then hour % stride == (Run No + seed) % stride; all evaluation hours retained.
